notes.text:
This update for libgepub fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2025-6196: Fixed an integer overflow in the EPUB archive handling code that can leads to massive memory allocation and application crash. (bsc#1244704)

notes.text: A flaw was found in libgepub, a library used to read EPUB files. The software mishandles file size calculations when opening specially crafted EPUB files, leading to incorrect memory allocations. This issue causes the application to crash. Known affected usage includes desktop services like Tumbler, which may process malicious files automatically when browsing directories. While no direct remote attack vectors are confirmed, any application using libgepub to parse user-supplied EPUB content could be vulnerable to a denial of service.
